parallel.requirements: The parent recognized ESM .mjs output, pure Node.js, manual --a parsing, local-module-only imports, black-box matching against the executable, and exact stdout/stderr/exit-code behavior for tested cases.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: After serial probing, the parent delegated implementation of /output files to agent-0 and a separate verification harness to agent-1, then kept parent ownership for joining the two child results and final delivery.
parallel.implementation: Agent-0 implemented delimiter constants, slugify, argparse behavior, and test4.mjs. The final implementation used a delimiter regex, hardcoded the executable-style prog string, and included an acknowledged untested --help=x corner.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent accepted the child-written /output tree, ran the verifier child's /tmp harness against it, read the four final files, and delivered test4.mjs plus lib/delimiters.mjs, lib/slugify.mjs, and lib/argparse.mjs.
parallel.verification: The implementation child ran smoke and differential checks, the verifier child built a 50-case byte-comparison harness, and the parent ran that harness successfully before closure.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite local tests passing, the current official evaluator failed the artifact at 49/166; the raw trajectory does not expose a parallel handoff, join, write, or monitoring failure that explains the shared incorrect behavior.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same ESM .mjs, /output, no external dependency, manual argparse, and black-box slugify requirements from the prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One main agent owned exploration, implementation, integration, verification, parser fixes, and final delivery without delegation or cross-agent handoffs.
serial.implementation: The serial agent wrote lib/charsets.mjs, lib/slugify.mjs, lib/argparse.mjs, and test4.mjs, then patched argparse formatting after comparing help and error output.
serial.integration_and_delivery: All modules were integrated in the local /output tree by the same actor, with test4.mjs importing the local argparse and slugify modules before final response.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran 56 value checks, 11 parser scenarios after normalization, and a final 12-case regression pass against the executable before closure.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The current official evaluator also failed the serial artifact at 49/166, indicating the single-agent local probe set did not cover all evaluator cases even though its sampled checks passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent kept exploratory and final join ownership, delegated implementation to agent-0, and delegated verification harness construction to agent-1.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The child prompt carried the full parent-derived behavioral spec and gave non-overlapping scopes: implementation in /output and verifier harness outside /output.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced handoffs, but the returned implementation and verifier results were compatible and consumed; no missing interface contract is evidenced.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote character-set, slugify, argparse, and entry modules, then patched the parser after observed help/error differences.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The file layout and behavior were closely similar, with minor parser implementation differences; neither path reached official correctness.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Both child results returned before closure; the parent ran the verifier harness and read the final implementation files after joining the swarm.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used a shared filesystem but with separated write scopes, so there is no observed collision or overwrite; serial had normal single-owner edits.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran implementation-child tests and then the verifier-child 50-case harness in the parent, reporting 50/50 passing before final file reads.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran value batteries, parser comparisons, applied parser fixes, and reran parser and value regression checks before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had independent harness construction and parent execution; serial had tighter local debugging. Both local acceptance sets missed official failures.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed within budget after 732.768 agent seconds, with two children and no timeout, and closed after parent-side harness execution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed within budget after 600.361 agent seconds, with no children and no timeout, and closed after final regression checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more wall/agent time and more tool stages because of delegation, but no direct budget exhaustion or unfinished child consequence is visible.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official evaluations are concordant: both parallel and serial failed with 49/166. Parallel differed procedurally by using two child agents after parent probing, but the children returned compatible outputs that the parent ran and inspected. Serial did the same style of probing, implementation, correction, and local verification in one timeline. The shared failure is therefore not explained by a parallel-specific coordination episode; it is more plausibly an ordinary black-box implementation shortfall or evaluator coverage beyond the sampled local tests.
parallel_contributors: Parent derived a sampled behavioral spec, delegated implementation and harness construction, joined both results, and accepted 50 local harness passes before official failure.
serial_contributors: Single agent derived a sampled behavioral spec, wrote and patched the implementation, accepted local value/parser tests, and also failed the official evaluator.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel hardcoded executable-style argparse program text and used a delimiter regex module; serial used a character-set module and patched argparse output after local comparison.
Both runs relied on finite black-box probes that local tests judged sufficient but that did not satisfy the official 166-sample evaluation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; no retained parallel coordination pattern

candidates.reason: Parallel had an explicit implementation owner: agent-0 was assigned to create the /output modules and did so.
The parent retained join and integration responsibility and ran the returned verifier harness against the child-written implementation.
The implementation child wrote the required /output entry and libraries, and the parent read and delivered those files.
The parent owned the end-to-end transition from probing to delegation, child result join, harness execution, final reads, and response.
The parent did serial probing before delegation, but the gate did not leave implementation unfinished or materially shorten closure; both children completed.
Investigation preceded implementation, but the later implementation, verifier harness, parent harness run, and final reads all completed without deadline-constrained truncation.
No indispensable path was deprived of worker capacity; implementation and verification were the two delegated paths and both returned.
The fan-out was only two children, the run did not time out, and no child budget exhaustion displaced required final work.
The implementation child had a broad but bounded task and returned a complete artifact; no child scope was left unfinished.

The implementation and verifier briefs included the task, /output destination, ESM constraints, no external dependencies, and the parent-derived behavioral spec; the shared official failure reflects sampled-spec incompleteness, not an omitted known requirement at delegation.
The child scopes had a usable contract: agent-0 would produce /output/test4.mjs and libraries, while agent-1 would create a harness targeting that entry point.
No known finding is shown lost between parent and children; the parent-derived spec appears in the child tasks and is reflected in returned work.
The returned handoffs were detailed but reduced by the parent into a concrete harness run and final file reads, not left unconsumed due to volume.
The parent consumed current child outputs after the swarm completed; no handoff describes a superseded workspace state used for later action.
The implementation child and verifier child returned compatible results: the harness targeted the produced Node entry and passed when the parent ran it.
Although official evaluation later failed, the parent-visible trajectory shows local differential harness execution and file inspection; no unresolved integrated mismatch was visible before closure.
There was no replacement child or retry episode in the parallel trajectory, so no checkpoint-free repeated work occurred.
